hero.headline: Practice Management Software for CA/CPA & Accounting Firms
hero.subheadline: Every client, engagement, workflow stage, checklist, review point and hour your team works — in one place, so partners know where every job stands without chasing anyone for an update.

status.text: Setu Workflow is a paid, multi-user cloud product for CA/CPA and accounting firms. Join the waiting list and we'll email you as soon as it opens for your firm.

body.headline: Why firms use it
paragraphs: Most firms run their practice on a spreadsheet of due dates, a WhatsApp group for review notes and a manager's memory of who is doing what. It works until the busy season, when a return sits in review for a week because nobody noticed it was waiting, or a query to the client was answered and then lost in a thread.

Setu Workflow gives the whole firm one record of the work: which engagements are open, which stage each one is in and who owns it, what is still outstanding on the checklist, which review points are blocking sign-off, and how the hours spent compare with the budget.

modules.headline: Everything you get
modules.subheadline: One connected system — Firm → Client → Engagement → Workflow → Checklist & Points — not a set of separate tools. Every module below is included in every plan.

items.title: Client Master
items.description: Client records with entity type, addresses, contacts, service lines, partner and manager. Your own custom fields, full activity history, search and filters, CSV import with a preview, CSV export and bulk ownership and status updates.

items.title: Engagement Master
items.description: Every job linked to its client, with engagement type, period, due dates, priority and budgeted hours. Partner, Manager, Reviewer and Preparer staffing, status lifecycle from Draft to Completed, assignment history, custom fields, CSV import and export.

items.title: Workflow templates & stages
items.description: Build versioned templates once — Preparation, Review, Partner sign-off — and apply them to engagements. Move work forward, return it with a reason, reassign, skip optional stages, complete or reopen, with every movement and stage age recorded.

items.title: Checklists
items.description: Stage-wise checklist templates with owners, due dates and required flags. Required items gate the workflow, items can be commented on, completions and reopenings are logged, and each person has their own checklist queue.

items.title: Queries & review points
items.description: Client questions, review points, knowledge instructions and internal issues in one numbered thread per engagement. Replies, explicit resolve, close and reopen, aging in days, and blocking points that hold the workflow until cleared or overridden.

items.title: Work allocation
items.description: Plan dated hours for each person across one or many engagements, preview before saving, reassign or cancel with history, and see weekly capacity and budget warnings before you commit the team's week.

items.title: Time & budget
items.description: Staff log hours against engagements and stages from My Time, then submit them. Managers correct submitted time with an audited reason. Budget, planned, actual and remaining hours on every engagement, with warnings at 80%, 90% and over budget.

items.title: Team capacity
items.description: Weekly capacity, planned load and available hours for every person, adjusted for leave, training, holidays and other time off. Find who is free before assigning the next job.

items.title: My Work & My Day
items.description: Each person opens to their own day: workflow stages they own, checklist items and points assigned to them, planned work and what is due — then updates progress and logs the hours against it.

items.title: Dashboard & reports
items.description: A Needs Attention view for overdue engagements, blocking points, stalled stages and budget overruns, plus engagement health and deadlines. Six reports — Engagement Status, Budget vs Actual, Open Points Aging, Team Capacity, Workflow Aging and Checklist Progress — each exportable to CSV.

items.title: Firm administration
items.description: Offices across locations, users and email invitations, five ready-made roles from Firm Admin to Associate, custom roles with granular permissions, and firm settings for timezone, currency and standard weekly hours.

items.title: Subscription & access
items.description: Your firm's account owner redeems license keys in Admin → Subscription and chooses exactly which people have access. Add users any time through sales; renewals stack after the current plan.
